# Vendored pixelfx (MIT)

Source: https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx (v0.3.0 subset)
License: see LICENSE (MIT — Patch & Hugo Duprez)

Selected for 記憶帝國・女傑翻牌 juice:
- match/combo: hit-spark, crit-hit, firework-burst, mana-burst, snowflake-burst, collect-burst
- skill/boss: magic-circle-cast, rune-circle, spell-charge, frost-nova, sword-slash, double-slash, zap-hit
- clear/level-up: sunburst, confetti, level-up, blessing, feather-burst
- bond/heart: heart-pickup, xp-orb

Recolor via palette option to crimson (#c41e3a) / gold (#ffd700) / purple (#9b59ff).

ES modules under `core/` and `fx/`. Prefer bundling into `js/fx.js` IIFE for the PWA, or load with `<script type="module">`.
